title: What if you could time travel? But there's a catch.
idea: There's a catch, episode 7: Spud loses a world final by a nose and time-travels to fix it; every fix breaks something bigger: his best friend hurt, then on his rival's side, then, when the watch bursts, a stranger one year earlier

hook.what: a world final in the rain at the finish tape: Wedge's nose ahead of Spud's, Chip with his sign behind the barrier, the watch clicking

rain, blue light: medics load Chip into the ambulance; Spud, gold medal round his neck, frozen
the watch clicks again; the rain rises
Spud drags Chip by the arm up the stand steps to the empty top row

close: Spud winds the crown hard with both gloves, a crack runs across the glass
the stadium empties round Spud, floodlights die, snow, leaves and rain swirl at once
close: the watch bursts in his glove, glass, gears and springs flying
grey dawn, the empty stadium in the rain: Chip jogging; Spud grabs him; Chip shoves him off, scared
Spud on his knees in a puddle by the broken watch; Chip comes back and holds out his hand
